verdict.rationale: Formant exposes substantial API/SDK surface (Agent SDK for telemetry, commands, teleop; Cloud SDK for data export; Admin API for custom commands; RealtimeSDK/toolkit for building custom apps and UI elements), suggesting many UI actions can be replicated programmatically. However, there is no explicit claim or evidence of full UI/API parity, and a public OpenAPI/swagger spec could not be found (404s), while UI-centric features like fleet orchestration dashboards, AI-assistant-driven analytics, and dashboard building via SQL/AI assistant are not clearly shown to be fully API-accessible. Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement or complete OpenAPI spec, and API-level access to fleet orchestration/analytics-dashboard configuration equivalent to the UI.
